Synopsis:
    Italian gaming group Lottomatica is acquiring Spanish rival Cirsa Enterprises for €3B in an all-share deal. The deal diversifies Lottomatica beyond Italy, brings Blackstone in as a 24% shareholder, and introduces casino/offline exposure that dilutes Lottomatica's online-first profile. Synergies of €115M are cited as justification, alongside cheap entry pricing vs. analyst estimates. Strategic rationale includes hedging against increasing Italian market competition (Flutter/Snaitech) and capturing faster Spanish GDP/disposable income growth. Key risks: integration complexity, reduced online revenue mix, and M&A track record in European gambling being spotty.
